HF_9MHz_full_depth.name: HF_9MHz_full_depth
HF_9MHz_full_depth.role: Full-depth, lower-resolution sounding; primary deep-ocean stress test.
HF_9MHz_full_depth.note: REASON HF uses 9 MHz center frequency, 1 MHz bandwidth, about 300 m vertical resolution in ice, and full-depth sounding to about 30 km.

VHF_60MHz_shallow.name: VHF_60MHz_shallow
VHF_60MHz_shallow.role: High-resolution shallow sounding and clutter discrimination support.
VHF_60MHz_shallow.note: REASON VHF shallow sounding uses 60 MHz center frequency, 10 MHz bandwidth, about 30 m vertical resolution in ice, and shallow sounding to about 3 km.

VHF_60MHz_full_depth_lowDR.name: VHF_60MHz_full_depth_lowDR
VHF_60MHz_full_depth_lowDR.role: Full-depth VHF sensitivity check with reduced radiometric fidelity.
VHF_60MHz_full_depth_lowDR.note: The REASON paper describes full-depth VHF to about 30 km as single-bit, low dynamic range; v2 models that as a conservative SNR penalty.

surface_clutter_model.applies_to: VHF 60 MHz modes; classification effect limited to VHF shallow sounding
surface_clutter_model.mechanism: off-nadir surface clutter represented as an apparent shallow subsurface echo
surface_clutter_model.source: Blankenship et al. 2024 REASON; Castelletti et al. 2017; Scanlan et al. 2020
surface_clutter_model.caveat: Amplitude and apparent depth are deterministic sensitivity proxies, not antenna-pattern or interferometric phase simulations.

caveat: This is a first-order sensitivity simulation, not a full REASON link budget or processing pipeline.
